Intended to be a military-grade gender augmentation tool with regenerative and combat-enhancing capabilities, the virus mutated during early-stage testing, resulting in widespread, uncontrolled infection.

The full transformation spans approximately 4 weeks, with complete viral saturation and anatomical mutation by the end of the month. Transformation is irreversible and highly variable.
